Schema dependency: campaign_recipients needs columns tracking_id (uuid unique), open_count (int default 0), click_count (int default 0), clicked_url (text). These are expected to be added by the sister 5.1.2 migration add_campaign_recipients_indexes.sql. Code degrades gracefully (returns false) if columns are missing.
Status transitions implemented: sent/delivered -> opened on first open; -> clicked on any click. Clicks never demote to opened.
Base64 decoder tolerates URL-safe (-_) and standard (+/) alphabets and missing padding, rejects embedded control chars.
Pixel route always returns a GIF even when tracking_id parse fails, so email clients never see JSON errors and tracking_id validity is not leaked.
No e2e tests added — sister tasks own the recipients fixture; tracking endpoints are exercised through the email send flow once 5.1.2/5.1.3 land.

Inlined redis ConnectionOptions in worker (BullMQ vendors its own ioredis) instead of touching src/lib/queue/ which is sister 5.1.2 scope. Job payload type defined locally to mirror documented shape. Custom backoff strategy 5s/30s/5min registered on Worker.settings.
